text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》,
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》,

text: the podcast where we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客里,我们用简单的英语
zh_hant: 在這個播客裡,我們用簡單的英語

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 进行真实的对话,帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 進行真實的對話,幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Neil.
And you can watch a video version of this podcast
zh: 你可以观看这个播客的视频版本,
zh_hant: 你可以觀看這個播客的影片版本,

text: and get a free worksheet at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil.
How are you?
Hi, Georgie.
Yeah, I'm very good.
I'm excited.
Why?
I'm going to a birthday party.
zh: 我要去参加一个生日派对。
zh_hant: 我要去參加一個生日派對。

text: Whose birthday party?
My sister's.
Your sister.
Well, that's funny, because today we are talking about brothers and sisters.
zh: 嗯,这挺有意思的,因为今天我们要聊的正是兄弟姐妹。
zh_hant: 嗯,這挺有意思的,因為今天我們要聊的正是兄弟姐妹。

text: Or siblings .
Yeah.
Do you have any siblings , Georgie?
I do, I have one sister.
She is younger,
but she is taller and more mature
zh: 但她比我高,也比我成熟,
zh_hant: 但她比我高,也比我成熟,

text: and more sensible than I am.
How about you?
Exactly the same.
Yes, I have a younger sister, but she's a bit more grown up than me.
zh: 是的,我有一个妹妹,但她比我更成熟一点。
zh_hant: 是的,我有一個妹妹,但她比我更成熟一點。

text: A better version of you?
Yeah, definitely.
Are you similar ?
Well, are there any similarities between you and your sister?
zh: 我是说,你和你妹妹之间有相似之处吗?
zh_hant: 我是說,你和你妹妹之間有相似之處嗎?

text: Well, I mean, physically we don't look similar ,
zh: 嗯,我是说,外表上我们不太像,
zh_hant: 嗯,我是說,外表上我們不太像,

text: but some people say we do.
I can't really see it.
But I think some aspects of our personality
zh: 不过我觉得我们性格上的
zh_hant: 不過我覺得我們性格上的

text: are similar .
We like some of the same things.
zh: 我们喜欢一些相同的东西。
zh_hant: 我們喜歡一些相同的東西。

text: It's, you know, it's good when we meet, but we don't meet very often.
zh: 见面的时候感觉挺好的,不过我们不常见面。
zh_hant: 見面的時候感覺挺好的,不過我們不常見面。

text: How often?
Every few months.
Yeah.
Because, you know, she lives in a different city
zh: 因为,你知道,她住在另一个城市,
zh_hant: 因為,你知道,她住在另一個城市,

text: and has her family and life's busy.
zh: 有自己的家庭,生活也很忙。
zh_hant: 有自己的家庭,生活也很忙。

text: Yeah.
I'm lucky because my sister lives in London.
zh: 我很幸运,因为我妹妹住在伦敦。
zh_hant: 我很幸運,因為我妹妹住在倫敦。

text: So we are able to see each other quite regularly.
So, Georgie, are you close to your sister?
zh: 那么,Georgie,你和你妹妹关系亲密吗?
zh_hant: 那麼,Georgie,你和你妹妹關係親密嗎?

text: Yes.
I would say that we are close .
zh: 我会说我们关系很亲密。
zh_hant: 我會說我們關係很親密。

text: Growing up, we weren't so close .
zh: 小时候,我们没那么亲密。
zh_hant: 小時候,我們沒那麼親密。

text: I would say.
Although I think she disagrees.
zh: 不过我觉得她不这么认为。
zh_hant: 不過我覺得她不這麼認為。

text: But since we went travelling together,
zh: 但自从我们一起去旅行之后,
zh_hant: 但自從我們一起去旅行之後,

text: we became closer
because we had this kind of special experience together.
zh: 因为我们一起有过那种特别的经历。
zh_hant: 因為我們一起有過那種特別的經歷。

text: We were very far away from home.
We had to do lots of difficult things,
zh: 我们得处理很多困难的事情,
zh_hant: 我們得處理很多困難的事情,

text: you know, organising.
We were, yeah, together against the world.
zh: 我们那时,嗯,就像共同对抗全世界。
zh_hant: 我們那時,嗯,就像共同對抗全世界。

text: So we became close .
I think
when we're together, we get on well .
zh: 我们在一起的时候,相处得很好。
zh_hant: 我們在一起的時候,相處得很好。

text: But then we can go a long period of time where we don't really talk, and that's OK.
zh: 但有时候我们会有很长一段时间不怎么联系,这也没关系。
zh_hant: 但有時候我們會有很長一段時間不怎麼聯絡,這也沒關係。

text: It's life.
So, you have a sister and you get on well .
zh: 那么,你有一个妹妹,而且相处得很好。
zh_hant: 那麼,你有一個妹妹,而且相處得很好。

text: But do you wish that you had more siblings ?
zh: 但你希望自己有更多兄弟姐妹吗?
zh_hant: 但你希望自己有更多兄弟姐妹嗎?

text: Yes.
I wish I had a brother.
zh: 我希望我有个哥哥或弟弟。
zh_hant: 我希望我有個哥哥或弟弟。

text: It might sound strange,
zh: 这听起来可能有点奇怪,
zh_hant: 這聽起來可能有點奇怪,

text: but I've always wanted
to know what a boy in my family would look like.
zh: 我家里如果有个男孩会是什么样子。
zh_hant: 我家裡如果有個男孩會是什麼樣子。

text: Yeah, it might change the dynamic a little bit, though.
zh: 是啊,不过那可能会让家庭氛围有点不一样。
zh_hant: 是啊,不過那可能會讓家庭氛圍有點不一樣。

text: What about you?
Yeah, when I was younger,
I thought it would be nice to have a brother,
zh: 觉得如果有个哥哥会挺好的,
zh_hant: 覺得如果有個哥哥會挺好的,

text: an older brother to kind of show you the way.
zh: 一个年长的哥哥可以给你指引方向。
zh_hant: 一個年長的哥哥可以給你指引方向。

text: Yeah.
Because probably, you know, as the older sibling ,
zh: 因为,你知道,作为年长的孩子,
zh_hant: 因為,你知道,作為年長的孩子,

text: you're kind of, you get
to do everything first,
and that's sometimes good and sometimes bad.
zh: 这有时候是好事,有时候是坏事。
zh_hant: 這有時候是好事,有時候是壞事。

text: But it's funny because the stereotype of older siblings
zh: 不过有趣的是,人们对年长兄姐的刻板印象
zh_hant: 不過有趣的是,人們對年長兄姐的刻板印象

text: is usually that they are more responsible
and sensible
because they had, you know, the more rules growing up.
And then when the younger sibling comes, they have less rules or fewer rules.
zh: 然后等弟弟妹妹出生后,规矩就少了。
zh_hant: 然後等弟弟妹妹出生後,規矩就少了。

text: But I think that my sister is the more serious
zh: 但我觉得我妹妹反而更认真、
zh_hant: 但我覺得我妹妹反而更認真、

text: and better behaved one.
We heard similar ,
which means almost, but not exactly the same.
zh: 意思是几乎一样,但不完全相同。
zh_hant: 意思是幾乎一樣,但不完全相同。

text: We had get on with , which means
zh: 我们还学到了get on with这个短语,意思是
zh_hant: 我們還學到了get on with這個短語,意思是

text: to have a good relationship with someone, for example.
zh: 和某人关系融洽,比如说,
zh_hant: 和某人關係融洽,比如說,

text: I get on well with my sister.
We heard the adjective close.
If two people are close, they like each other and they talk to each other often.
zh: 如果两个人close,意味着他们彼此喜欢,也经常交流。
zh_hant: 如果兩個人close,意味著他們彼此喜歡,也經常交流。

text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部內容。

text: You can find a worksheet on our website
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到学习单,
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到學習單,

text: and lots more episodes to help you practice.
zh: 还有更多可以帮助你练习的节目。
zh_hant: 還有更多可以幫助你練習的節目。

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Join us again next time when we'll talk about what worries us.
zh: 下次再见,我们将聊聊让我们担心的事情。
zh_hant: 下次再見,我們將聊聊讓我們擔心的事情。

text: See you then.
Goodbye.
